description: Aru carries the north lantern at Quiet Rise.
Evin holds the south bell at Salt Court.
At the Chalk Stair, Aru and Evin agree to share stewardship for this crossing only, then chalk one temporary route mark.
At the Chalk Stair at tick 11, Aru reports waiting through the agreed bell and that Evin did not come; the note scopes the agreement to this crossing only and asserts no other duty or breach.
